_comment_security: All API keys are placeholders. Set the corresponding environment variable instead, e.g. export SILICONFLOW_API_KEY=sk-... / DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=... / OPENAI_API_KEY=... — see README §4.

siliconflow.comment: SiliconFlow GLM-4.7 / GLM5 — OpenAI-compatible, fast & stable in China

deepseek.comment: DeepSeek-V3 (latest chat model) — fast, high quality

deepseek-r1.comment: DeepSeek-R1 (reasoning model) — slow (~4min) but deeper reasoning

gemini-flash.comment: Gemini 2.0 Flash — 1M context window, no KB compression needed, fast & free

gemini-pro.comment: Gemini 2.5 Pro — 2M context window, most powerful Gemini model

poe.comment: Requires proxy — api.poe.com blocked without VPN. Set proxy_url or HTTPS_PROXY.
